title: Measured Library root Add clearance
summary: Replaces the fixed Library list/grid tail spacer with the actual viewport overlap from the existing floating root chrome measurement plus 16pt. Viewport measurement avoids scroll-content feedback and double reservation on already-inset layouts. Root Add and modal/pushed Cook behavior unchanged.
